title: Northgate Console — TEST docs
badge: Fake B2B admin · not a live bank
intro: This is the product spec for the QA challenge console. If the UI or the API disagrees with this page, treat it as a defect. Same area I tested at work: Access & Identity, account structures, roles. Not payment-provider rails. Product UI is English on purpose.
footer: Mykhailo Kovalenko · Senior General QA Engineer

blocks.text: Northgate Console is a fake TEST back-office. It is not a live bank. Transfers are internal book-to-book between accounts in this workspace. There are no payment-provider flows.

items: Sign in and sign out.
Filter, sort, paginate, create, edit, delete, open, freeze/unfreeze, and export corporate accounts.
Create internal transfers and filter the transfer list.
Invite members and read roles.
Read an audit log of login, freeze, create, update, delete, transfer, invite.
Inspect live REST calls in the API tab.

blocks.text: Compare three sources: this spec, the table in the UI, and the Network / API tab. They must match.

The REST layer is a Service Worker. Chrome DevTools → Network → Fetch/XHR shows the calls (often marked from ServiceWorker). State still lives in localStorage. First paint may show “Loading console…” until the worker is ready. Playwright E2E can waitForResponse. Playwright request (Node HTTP) does not hit this fake API.

rows: Hunter score on the challenge page

blocks.text: Reset app + score on the challenge page clears these keys and reloads seed data.
Only this user can sign in. The login form is pre-filled with the demo email. Session line after login: Ada Chen · Admin. While Sign in is in flight, login-submit is disabled.
Success: 200. Body has token and user. The token is stored and sent on later calls as Bearer. A LOGIN audit row is written with result OK.
Wrong email or password: 401 Unauthorized. This is not 403. 403 means authenticated but not allowed. A failed login is unauthenticated.
Success: 204 and empty body. The token must be removed. Reload after logout must show the login form, not the console. GET /me without a token must return 401.
Requires Bearer token. 200 returns the demo user. Missing or wrong token: 401 on every route except login.

rows: Error text after a failed login

blocks.text: Tab Accounts. Seed has 8 rows. UI page size is 5. API default pageSize is 20 if the query omits it. Accounts are full CRUD. Freeze/Unfreeze is a separate PATCH, not the Edit form.

rows: Yes. New row on page 1. Audit CREATE / OK
Yes. Next GET and reload. Audit UPDATE / OK
Yes, unless 409 pending transfers. Audit DELETE / OK
Status change must persist. Not PUT

blocks.text: Open accounts must equal the number of Active rows (6 on seed). Frozen = 1. Closed = 1. Pending transfers = count of transfers with status Pending (2 on seed).
Apply filters sends query params. Clear resets them and page to 1. Empty list shows “No accounts match these filters.”

rows: Case-insensitive substring on holder or IBAN
All | Active | Frozen | Closed. Active must hide Frozen and Closed
All | EUR | USD | GBP. Must keep only that currency
Inclusive: balance <= max. A row with balance 150 must stay when max=150
Sort by client name (holder), not by IBAN

items: Columns: Client, IBAN, Type, CCY, Balance, Status, Actions (Edit, Freeze/Unfreeze, Delete).
Balance in the table must match GET /accounts and GET /accounts/:id (Ada Chen is 4200.50, not 4200).
Client header (sort-holder) sorts by holder. Activate with click, Enter, or Space.
Previous / Next. Page 1 disables Previous. Last page disables Next.
Export CSV uses current filters, page=1, pageSize=100. File northgate-accounts.csv. Columns: id,holder,iban,type,currency,balance,status.

blocks.text: Form Add account. New row is inserted at the top of the list (page 1). Types: Current, Operating, Payroll, Escrow. Currencies: EUR, USD, GBP. Status: Active, Frozen, Closed. Balance default 0. While the POST is in flight, account-create-submit is disabled.

Every row has Edit. The account drawer also has Edit account. The form is a modal (role=dialog, aria-modal) and is prefilled. Save sends PUT with holder, iban, type, currency, balance, status. The change must persist: next GET and reload show the new values. Cancel, overlay click, and Escape must not call the API. After close, focus returns to the control that opened the dialog. Account id does not change. Same validation as create. Duplicate IBAN is 409 unless it is this row’s own IBAN. While PUT is in flight, account-edit-submit is disabled.

Every row has Delete. Confirm modal first (role=dialog, aria-modal). Only one dialog at a time. Cancel, overlay click, and Escape must not call the API. After close, focus returns to the Delete button. The delete must persist: next GET list and reload omit the row. If this account has a Pending transfer (from or to), API returns 409 ACCOUNT_HAS_PENDING_TRANSFERS and the row stays. Unknown id: 404. On seed, acc-1 and acc-5 have pending transfers, so delete must fail. acc-6 Closed has none — delete must succeed.

Click a row. GET /accounts/:id. Unknown id: 404. Drawer shows IBAN, type, currency, Balance (API), status, account id. Copy IBAN writes the IBAN to the clipboard. Edit account opens the same PUT form as the row Edit button. Related transfers are items where from or to equals this id. Close clears the selection.

Closed rows have no Freeze. Active shows Freeze. Frozen shows Unfreeze. Confirm modal first. Confirm sends PATCH { "status": "Frozen" } or { "status": "Active" } — not PUT. Edit/PUT is a different contract and must persist field changes. After PATCH, the new status must persist: next GET and reload show it. Toast: Request accepted: Frozen|Active. Cancel, overlay click, and Escape must not call the API. After close, focus returns to Freeze/Unfreeze.

rows: account-edit-holder / account-edit-iban / account-edit-type / account-edit-ccy / account-edit-balance / account-edit-status

blocks.text: Internal book-to-book only. Same currency. From and To dropdowns list Active accounts only. A new transfer gets status Pending and a ref like NG-TX-######. While Create transfer is in flight, transfer-submit is disabled.

rows: Transfer object, status Pending. Debit source, credit target. Audit TRANSFER / PENDING
from, to, or amount missing / amount ≤ 0

blocks.text: UI locators: transfer-form, transfer-from, transfer-to, transfer-amount, transfer-submit, transfer-error, transfer-filters, transfer-status, transfer-min, transfer-max, transfer-apply, transfer-table, transfer-row, transfer-ref.
Tab Access. Members and roles for this TEST workspace. Invite creates status Invited.
Roles you can invite: Viewer, Member, Admin, Contractor. The role in the table must equal the role you sent. Admin must stay Admin.
Missing name or email without @ : 400 { "error": "Name and email are required." }. Audit INVITE / OK on success. While Invite is in flight, invite-submit is disabled.
UI locators: invite-form, invite-name, invite-email, invite-role, invite-submit, member-table, member-row, member-role.
GET /sandbox/api/v1/audit returns { items }. Newest first. Max 40 rows stored. Columns: Time, Actor, Action, Target, Result.

Call from the console page via fetch. Chrome Network and the API tab both show the live responses. Accounts CRUD: POST create, GET list/detail, PUT edit, DELETE remove. PATCH is freeze/unfreeze only — do not mix it with Edit.
UI locators: api-routes, api-log. The Docs button on the challenge page opens this spec.

items: UI: login, filters, add account, edit, delete, pagination, drawer, freeze confirm, transfer, invite, CSV, logout + reload.
Dialogs: Edit and Confirm are role=dialog, aria-modal. Cancel, overlay click, and Escape must not call the API. Focus returns to the opener. Only one dialog at a time.
Keyboard: Client header Enter/Space sorts. Submit buttons disable while the request is in flight (no double create/edit/transfer/invite/login).
API: same routes in the API tab or DevTools Network. Assert status and body against this spec.
UI vs API: table balance, KPI vs Active count, PUT vs next GET, PATCH freeze vs next GET.
Negative: wrong password, empty invite, duplicate IBAN on create and on edit, delete with pending transfer, currency mismatch, amount above balance, max balance = 150, search lowercase names.
Locators: data-testid on every control above. Do not rely on CSS classes.
Playwright E2E: page.goto('/sandbox/'), getByTestId, waitForResponse.
Playwright request fixture will not reach this in-browser API. Do not write API tests that expect a real HTTP server here.

blocks.text: The challenge page lists planted-bug hints. This spec does not name them. Use the spec as the expected result.
